'''Drexsler''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[First Lieutenant/Legends|first lieutenant]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RebelFirstLieutenantTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Captain Drexsler]]
Drexsler appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
